summary: Bump go.mod go directive to 1.26.5 to clear reachable stdlib CVE GO-2026-5856 (crypto/tls ECH privacy leak) and meet the library's repo-wide Go floor.
reason: The generator emitted 'go 1.26.4', which govulncheck flags for GO-2026-5856 (reachable via the MCP HTTPS server and reachability probe) and which is below the public library's 1.26.5 supply-chain floor. Bumping the go directive fixes both.
validated_outcome: publish validate govulncheck: No vulnerabilities found.
